title: Flammable Slime Bomb
summary: Throw this unique bomb for 1d4 + 2 Fire and a Fire surface.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft. Deals 1d4 + 2 Fire on impact.
fields.Surface: 10 ft radius for 2 turns. Fire deals 1d4 Fire per turn and applies Burning. The bomb itself lists Burning for 5 turns.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Auntie Ethel. Cannot be bought or crafted.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
